name: Beginner workouts
intro: Never worked out, or starting over after a long break? These guides show you exactly what to do on day one, how much is enough, and how to build from there without getting hurt or burned out.

name: Home workouts
intro: Short routines you can do in the living room with your body weight, a wall, or a chair. Most take 10 to 20 minutes and need zero equipment.

name: Low impact and joint friendly
short: Easy on knees, hips and back
intro: Moves that get your heart rate up and build strength without jumping or pounding. Good for sore knees, extra weight, or anyone who wants to move without the aches.

name: Weight loss
intro: Plain answers on losing weight in a way you can keep up: walking plans, realistic expectations, and the habits that matter more than any single workout.

name: Nutrition basics
intro: How much protein you need, how to plan simple meals for the week, and how to eat well without strict diets or counting every bite.

name: Over 40, 50 and 60
intro: Strength, balance and energy for the second half of life. Safe, steady routines for people in their 40s, 50s, 60s and beyond, including seated options.

name: Motivation and habits
intro: How to stick with it when life gets busy: small habits, realistic schedules for parents and workers, and what to do on the days you do not feel like it.

name: Recovery and sleep
short: Rest is part of the plan
intro: Sleep, rest days and recovery are where your body actually gets stronger. Learn how much you need and how to get more of it.
